A rear-seat entertainment system keeps passengers engaged on longer journeys. The navigation system provides reliable turn-by-turn guidance, and the exterior parking camera rear assists with maneuvering in tight spaces.

Safety and security receive comprehensive treatment across the platform. Multiple airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and anti-whiplash front head restraints work together to protect occupants. The NissanConnect emergency communication system and security system provide additional peace of mind. Available features like auto high-beam headlights and rain-sensing wipers enhance visibility and convenience during various driving conditions.

The Lifetime Powertrain Warranty demonstrates confidence in this vehicle's durability and provides valuable protection for your investment. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the Armada Platinum firsthand and discuss how its combination of luxury, capability, and proven reliability can serve your family for years to come.

Additional highlights include a multi-zone climate control system, rain-sensing wipers, an aerial view display system, and a universal garage door opener. The Mustang Mach-E GT is equipped with a lithium-ion traction battery and supports plug-in electric fast charging, making it an ideal choice for drivers seeking innovation and excitement in an electric SUV. Be sure to call or visit Surprise Ford to discover more. Your new favorite vehicle awaits - don't let someone else drive it home!

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

This well-equipped Tahoe blends capability with comfort, making it an excellent choice for families seeking a luxury SUV. Contact us today to schedule your test drive and experience the High Country difference.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

2017 Jaguar F-PACE 35t Prestige Sport Utility 4D The Supercharged British Maverick of Sports-Sedan Agility and Luxury Utility

The 2017 Jaguar F-PACE 35t Prestige represents a historic, paradigm-shifting milestone for the legendary British marque, marking Jaguar's highly anticipated, award-winning grand debut into the luxury crossover segment. Engineered from a blank canvas to completely shatter the stereotype of the traditional, soft-roading family utility vehicle, the F-PACE is heavily built on an advanced, ultra-lightweight Lightweight Aluminum Architecturecomposed of 80% aluminum. Positioned at the premium, tech-forward Prestige tier, this athletic five-passenger crossover layers a whisper-quiet, hand-stitched leather sanctuary over a track-bred performance chassis. It serves as a commanding, high-impact mobile office for professionals during the week and an aggressive all-wheel-drive touring asset on the weekend, handling daily travel with absolute mechanical poise.

Under the long, sculpted aluminum hood lies an absolute masterpiece of modern performance engineering: a ferocious 3.0-liter Twin-Vortex Roots-type Supercharged DOHC V6 engine, straight from the F-TYPE sports car. This high-output powerplant hammers out a fierce 340 horsepower at 6,500 RPM and a robust 332 lb-ft of torque available at 4,500 RPM. This immediate, linear power curve is managed by an advanced, smooth-shifting ZF 8-speed automatic transmission featuring steering-wheel-mounted satin aluminum paddle shifters and an elegant, rising rotary gear selector. Rocketing this luxury cruiser from 0 to 60 mph in a blistering, sports-car-rivaling 5.4 seconds, the supercharged V6 provides an instantaneous surge of highway passing muscle accompanied by a rich, snarling mechanical exhaust note.

The driving experience is heavily characterized by its surgical handling precision, flat-folding cornering stability, and absolute high-speed composure on the interstate. Featuring a sophisticated, F-TYPE-derived independent double-wishbone front suspension and an advanced Integral Link rear suspension setup, the F-PACE tracks straight with unparalleled agility. Performance is managed by Jaguar's intelligent Instinctive All-Wheel Drive (AWD) system, which runs with a heavy rear-wheel power bias during normal conditions to maintain classic sports-car dynamics, but can shift torque to the front wheels in milliseconds upon detecting slip. Standard JaguarDrive Control allows you to instantly alter the vehicle's personality across Eco, Dynamic, Normal, and Rain/Ice/Snow modes reconfiguring throttle mapping, transmission shift points, and steering weight to ensure a deeply planted feel on any tarmac.

On the exterior, the 2017 F-PACE executes a stunning styling triumph, showcasing bold, wind-tunnel-carved proportions and prestigious British aesthetic trim details, featuring:

  • An imposing, low-slung front fascia anchored by a prominent gloss-black mesh main grille layout and automatic High-Intensity Discharge (HID) Xenon headlights

  • Sleek, signature J-Blade LED daytime running lights and a muscular, power-bulge hood that cleanly optimizes engine cooling and front-end downforce

  • Elegant, wind-tunnel-carved body contours complemented by signature F-TYPE LED taillights that wrap dramatically around the wide-track rear profile

  • Striking 19-inch 7-split-spoke alloy wheels wrapped in premium all-season tires that perfectly fill out its muscular flared arches and athletic stance

  • Premium functional details including power-folding heated side mirrors, rear privacy glass, a panoramic glass roof, and dual polished performance exhaust outlets

Inside, the Prestige cabin completely moves away from basic utilitarian layouts, treating passengers to a driver-centric, ultra-premium sanctuary lined with impeccable craftsmanship, technical textures, and a signature sweeping dashboard wrap, offering:

  • Deeply contoured front comfort sport seats draped in premium, heated Taurus leather upholstery with 4-way power lumbar support and driver-side memory settings

  • A premium, leather-wrapped multifunction sport steering wheel featuring standard heating elements and integrated audio and cruise controls

  • A sharp color center display monitor managed by the intuitive InControl Touch infotainment systemfeaturing built-in navigation and smartphone integration

  • Modern conveniences including standard proximity Smart Key with Push-Button Ignition, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a 5-inch digital driver information cluster display

  • An immersive, high-output 380-Watt Meridian 11-Speaker Premium Sound System meticulously engineered with an advanced acoustic insulation network to seal out highway noise

Practicality and interior space utilization are where the hatchback crossover design completely dominates traditional midsize luxury sedans. Bypassing restrictive truck cargo layouts, the power liftgate opens wide with a low liftover height to reveal a highly generous, class-leading 33.5 cubic feet of cargo space behind the second row. Utilizing the functional 40/20/40 split-folding rear bench seats, the backrests stow completely flat in seconds to create a massive, versatile load floor providing an ideal area to transport professional media gear packages, large travel luggage sets, or commercial marketing inventory without encroaching on passenger comfort.

Fuel capacity is a highly capable 16.6 gallons, maximizing your open-road cruising range and heavily minimizing time-wasting, expensive interruptions at the commercial pump during extended travel. While engineered primarily for sports-car performance and supercharged V6 torque, the aerodynamic aluminum architecture optimizes efficiency to achieve a respectable EPA-estimated 18 MPG city / 23 MPG highway (20 MPG combined). When professional trailering or hauling tasks call, this robust supercharged powertrain supports a massive maximum towing capacity of up to 5,290 lbs, making it a premier asset for pulling utility trailers or recreational equipment.

Safety is world-class, utilizing an ultra-high-strength steel and aluminum passenger safety cage engineered with advanced energy-absorbing front and rear crumple zones to displace impact forces. The 2017 model comes factory-equipped with a comprehensive suite of active driver protective aids, including:

  • All Surface Progress Control (ASPC) a low-speed launch system for slick surfaces

  • Dynamic Stability Control (DSC) and Traction Control

  • Front and Rear Parking Distance Sensors

  • Autonomous Emergency Braking (AEB) and Lane Departure Warning

  • High-resolution Backup Camera with dynamic grid guidelines

An advanced airbag protective network including dual front, front side-impact, and full-length side curtain protection works invisibly to guarantee absolute driving peace of mind through stressful daily commutes, tight urban corporate parking decks, or sudden severe downpours.

The 2017 Jaguar F-PACE 35t Prestige AWD is a beautifully sculpted, tech-forward, and relentlessly athletic crossover vehicle that perfectly bridges the gap between raw sports-car precision and everyday premium utility. It is the definitive choice for the professional or daily driver who demands a distinctive, high-end British presence on the road, backed by a legendary supercharged drivetrain that handles every journey with absolute mastery.
